title: Microsoft Teams chats and files
whyItMatters: Teams keeps cached chats, channel posts, meeting details and downloaded files. It shows the employer, colleagues and projects the person worked with.
source: Microsoft Learn, Clear the Teams client cache (new Teams path under Packages/MSTeams_LocalCache): https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/microsoftteams/teams-administration/clear-teams-cache
notes: New Teams (MSIX). Classic Teams kept data in the roaming folder under Microsoft Teams. Signing out of Teams does not remove the cache; the app has to be reset.
